description:
**Hiring – Factory Operations Manager / Production Head**

**Company:** *Infinity Crest Group Pvt.Ltd*

**Group Industry**: *Food Manufacturing – Parotta \& Chapathi / Ready\-to\-Eat \& Ready\-to\-Heat Job*

**Title:** *Factory Operations Manager / Production Manager / Production Head*

**Location**: *Keel Ayanambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu*

**Employment Type**: *Full\-Time*

**Openings**: *1*

**Experience***: 8–15 Years*

**Salary**: *₹1,00,000 per month*

**Working Days**: *6 Days per Week*

**Working Hours**: *Flexible / Shift\-Based*

**Language:** *Hindi – Mandatory*

**Job Summary**

* Infinity Crest Group is looking for an experienced Factory Operations Manager / Production Manager / Production Head to manage and oversee complete manufacturing operations at our food production facility.
* The ideal candidate must have strong previous experience in the Parotta and Chapathi manufacturing industry and should have hands\-on experience managing factory\-floor production, manpower, machinery, quality, food safety, production planning and operational efficiency.
* The candidate will be responsible for managing multiple production shifts, leading production teams, achieving daily production targets, reducing wastage and downtime, implementing SOPs, improving productivity and ensuring compliance with food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Production \& Factory Operations Plan, schedule and execute daily, weekly and monthly production. Manage production operations across multiple shifts. Ensure production targets and quality standards are achieved. Monitor productivity, yield, efficiency, wastage and downtime. Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions. Coordinate with Quality, Procurement, Maintenance and Logistics teams.

2\. Parotta \& Chapathi Production Manage end\-to\-end production processes for Parotta and Chapathi products. Ensure consistency in product quality, texture, size and production output. Optimize production processes and manpower utilization. Minimize production losses, wastage, rejection and rework. Ensure proper implementation of production SOPs and work instructions.

3\. Food Safety \& Quality Ensure compliance with FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO food safety standards. Maintain hygiene, sanitation and food safety standards on the factory floor. Coordinate with QA/QC teams to resolve quality issues. Support internal and external audits. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.

4\. Manpower Management Lead and manage Production Supervisors, Operators and Shop\-Floor Workers. Manage approximately 50–100 employees. Plan manpower allocation according to production requirements. Monitor attendance, productivity, performance and discipline. Train employees on production processes, hygiene, safety and SOPs. Build a strong and accountable production team.

5\. Machinery \& Maintenance Ensure efficient operation of production machinery and equipment. Coordinate with the maintenance team for preventive and breakdown maintenance. Minimize machine downtime and production interruptions. Monitor preventive maintenance schedules. Identify recurring machinery issues and support root\-cause analysis.

6\. Raw Material, Inventory \& Cost ControlMonitor raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods.Coordinate with Procurement for timely material availability.Control material wastage and production losses.Improve production yield and reduce manufacturing costs.Monitor production consumption and inventory levels.

7\. MIS \& ReportingPrepare daily, weekly and monthly production reports.Track production KPIs including yield, efficiency, wastage, downtime and manpower productivity.Provide production performance reports to management.Maintain proper production and compliance documentation.Use MS Excel, ERP/MIS and other reporting tools as required.8\. Process ImprovementStandardize production processes and implement SOPs.Drive Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives.Improve productivity and production efficiency.Reduce wastage, downtime, rework and production losses.Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

**Required Qualification Education:**

Bachelor's/Master's degree in: Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering or a related field.

**Required Experience**

*8–15 years of relevant experience* in food manufacturing / production / factory operations.

**Mandatory:** Previous hands\-on experience in Parotta and Chapathi manufacturing/production. Experience managing 50–100 employees. Strong experience in production planning and shop\-floor management. Experience managing multiple production shifts. Experience in food safety, hygiene and quality compliance.

**Required Skills**

Parotta \& Chapathi Manufacturing, Food Manufacturing Operations, Production Planning \& Control, Factory Operations, Production Management, Manpower Management, FSSAI Compliance, HACCP \& GMP, ISO Food Safety Standards, SOP Implementation, Lean Manufacturing, Process Optimization, Production KPI Management, Inventory \& Cost Control, Root Cause Analysis, Preventive Maintenance Coordination, Quality \& Hygiene Management, MS Excel / MS Office, ERP / MIS Systems, Hindi Communication – Mandatory

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a hands\-on factory\-floor leader who has proven experience in Parotta \& Chapathi production. Can independently manage large production teams. Has experience handling multiple shifts. Can achieve daily production targets under pressure. Has strong knowledge of food safety and hygiene. Can implement SOPs and improve production processes.Has excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced food manufacturing environment.

**Compensation \& Benefit Salary**: **₹1,00,000 per month PF \& ESI** – Applicable as per company policy and Performance\-based benefits as per company policy 6 working days per week Flexible / Shift\-based working hours

**Location:** *Keel Ayanambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu*

Interested Candidates

Candidates with strong Parotta \& Chapathi manufacturing experience and the required factory operations/production management experience are encouraged to apply.

title: City Manager - Operations
description:
About Fyn  
At Fyn, we’re on a mission to revolutionize last\-mile logistics through clean, efficient, and scalable electric mobility solutions. Born out of a vision to drive India’s transition to sustainable transportation, we began our journey as EV manufacturers. However, we soon identified a greater opportunity in EV\-as\-a\-Service — enabling businesses to adopt electric fleets without the operational complexities. In a fragmented EV logistics landscape, Fyn has emerged as a unifying force, bringing together technology, transparency, and process\-driven execution to redefine how goods move in the green economy.

Role Overview  
As City Manager you will be the single\-point leader for all operations in your assigned city. This role demands a strong ownership mindset and cross\-functional expertise—spanning operations, driver sourcing, service and asset management, infrastructure oversight, legal and compliance, public relations, and administration.

You will lead the city like an independent business unit, ensuring performance, compliance, and growth across all departments.  Key Responsibilities  City Operations Management

* End\-to\-end ownership of operational execution across sourcing, deployment, servicing, and logistics.
* Implement and monitor SOPs to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance across operations.
* Manage daily vehicle availability, uptime, and city\-level performance metrics.

Driver Sourcing \& Fleet Enablement

* Lead sourcing strategies and partnerships for onboarding and retention of EV drivers.
* Collaborate with sourcing and training teams to ensure driver readiness and productivity.

City P\&L Ownership

* Maintain a city\-specific budget, manage costs, and improve operational efficiency.
* Identify revenue opportunities and ensure targets are met across verticals.

Team Leadership \& Development

* Build, manage, and mentor a cross\-functional city team.
* Ensure alignment with Fyn’s culture, ethics, and leadership expectations.

Who You Are

* A proactive, entrepreneurial leader with the ability to manage end\-to\-end business functions.
* Capable of handling ambiguity, with a strong sense of ownership and execution bias.
* Relationship\-driven with strong negotiation and communication skills.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in operations, fleet/logistics management
* Prior experience managing city/regional business units, preferably in mobility or EV, logistics
* Strong understanding of P\&L, compliance, infrastructure, and workforce planning.
* Fluency in the local language is preferred.

Join Fyn  
Be a part of a bold, green revolution in mobility. Own the city. Build the future.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
Job Title: Production Manager – Chemical Manufacturing

Location: Chennai

Job Type: Full\-time

Experience Required: 8–10 years of relevant experience in chemical manufacturing or formulation\-based production environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Production Manager to oversee the setup, commissioning, and day\-to\-day operations of a chemical blending and manufacturing facility. The role will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, quality\-focused, and compliant production operations.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in chemical blending, specialty chemicals, surfactants, detergents, lubricants, process chemicals, or similar manufacturing environments.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily chemical production, blending, packaging, and dispatch operations.
* Ensure production follows approved formulations, SOPs, quality, and safety standards.
* Plan production schedules and optimize manpower, materials, and equipment.
* Monitor productivity, yield, wastage, downtime, and product quality.
* Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, and other internal teams.
* Ensure compliance with EHS, statutory, and manufacturing requirements.
* Lead and train production teams and drive continuous process improvement.

Experience and Technical Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
* 8–10 years of experience in chemical manufacturing or formulation\-based production.
* At least 3 years of experience in a production supervisory or managerial role.
* Experience in chemical blending, specialty chemicals, detergents, surfactants, or similar industries.
* Knowledge of production processes, quality systems, chemical safety, and manufacturing compliance.
* Strong leadership, problem\-solving, and team management skills.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,600,000\.00 per year

* Life insurance

description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Directly and through staff, manages and coordinates the operational activities for assigned functional area(s)/region(s). Ensures quality service and effective operations support for all assigned internal and external customers. Leads high performance teams of both entry level and skilled professionals by setting goals, providing ongoing feedback, measuring progress while recognizing success and building accountability with employees. Oversees adherence to corporate policies and procedures and ensures compliance with applicable laws and regulations within area of responsibility. Participates in the review and improvement of operational systems and procedures relevant to assigned units.  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
* Typically eight or more years of relevant experience
Preferred Skills/Experience
  

* Thorough knowledge of operational functions, systems, procedures, various products and/or services supported by the assigned area(s)
* Understanding of applicable Federal and State laws and regulations
* Thorough knowledge of applicable products, programs, financial analysis and related documentation as applicable
* Good organizational, managerial and project management skills
* Well\-developed customer relations skills
* Excellent interpersonal and verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent supervisory and management skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks
